name: nexus-ai-root
description: Nexus AI Root - Expense Tracker Monorepo

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -n "client,server" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
